correctness.rationale: Exact reflection principle gives F(t)=erfc(d/√(4Dt)), M_N=max τ_j and q_N=E[e^{-rM_N}]; restart renewal yields E T=(1−q)/(rq). As t→∞, log F(t)=−ct^-1/2+O(t^-1), c=d/√(πD); compactly localized Laplace principle on t=N^{2/3}u gives inf_{u>0}(ru+c/√u)=3(rc²/4)^{1/3}. F(N² z)^N→exp(−c/√z) and M_N/N²⇒c²/Y² with Y~Exp(1), producing Ψ(λ) and H(λ). Bounds for u=N²r→0 (truncated divergent mean) and u→∞ (global F bound) rule out escaping minimizers. Independent SciPy quadrature gave dimensionless trial optimum λ≈4.303683765 and H≈1.924581668; numbers are not part of proof. No claim of a unique optimizer or finite-size rate.
